title: The borrowed hour at Briar Station
intro: A departure is stamped before its passenger arrived. Someone altered the station record.

title: The borrowed hour at Hollow Exchange
intro: A dead telephone rang from inside a sealed booth. Its caller left a trail of service slips.

title: The borrowed hour at Mercer Street
intro: A witness entered a boarded-up shop. Four people remember a different entrance.

title: The borrowed hour at Marlow Hotel
intro: A guest left a key for a room absent from the hotel plan. The porter hid the original register.

title: The borrowed hour at Lantern Works
intro: The district went dark. One maintenance route stayed open throughout the blackout.

title: The borrowed hour at Bellwether Row
intro: A letter addressed to Pete arrived with tomorrow’s postmark. Its sender wants the delivery record erased.

title: The borrowed hour at Saint Elmo Arcade
intro: An unplugged cabinet printed a receipt. Its final player walked out before the score appeared.

title: The borrowed hour at Canal Observatory
intro: The observatory recorded a light below the canal. Someone moved the night watch’s equipment.

title: The borrowed hour at North Quay
intro: A ferry docked without a crew. Four witnesses left conflicting time-stamped route cards.

title: The borrowed hour at Ash Archive
intro: A sealed file contains Pete’s signature. The archive’s own records conceal who brought it in.
